papers.title_en: Macro Mondrian Conformal Risk Control
papers.authors: Julien Combes, Jean-Francois Coeurjolly, Alexandre Dervill{é}
papers.evidence: 面向单调损失函数的共形风险控制与分组保证
papers.tldr: 传统保形风险控制只保证数据分布上的边际风险，在类别不平衡时，含稀有目标的输入风险仍可能失控。本文提出Macro Mondrian Conformal Risk Control，用分类法给每个样本分配组，并按组概率对风险加权，使稀有样本贡献更大。方法结合Mondrian保形预测与macro-coverage思想，在两组语义分割数据集上展示。该工作将风险控制从边际平均扩展到用户定义组的平均。
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Risk Control (CRC) extends conformal prediction beyond the coverage setting to the control of general monotone loss functions, in a distribution-free and modelagnostic fashion. This makes it well-suited to problems with high-dimensional targets, such as the semantic segmentation task addressed in this work. However, CRC guarantees only marginal control, meaning that the risk is controlled on average over the data distribution. Under imbalanced distributions, the risk on inputs that contain rare objects may therefore remain uncontrolled, even when the marginal guarantee holds. We propose a new method that controls the risk on average over user-defined groups of the domain, drawing on Mondrian conformal prediction and macro-coverage algorithms. The method relies on a taxonomy, that is, a function that assigns a group to each data point, and reweights each point's risk by a coefficient that depends on its group probability, so that rare points contribute more than common ones. We illustrate the approach on two semantic segmentation datasets.

papers.title_en: Finite-Sample Optimal Conformal Prediction Sets under Covariate Shift
papers.authors: Zhongyang Li
papers.evidence: 协变量偏移下的保形预测集，具备有限样本最优性与加权保形校准
papers.tldr: 在已知协变量密度比的协变量偏移下，研究目标分布上期望长度最小的共形预测集。方法将逆条件密度得分与随机加权共形校准结合，并用分位点、核直方图及森林加权估计器近似理论最优规则，通过重采样选择估计器与调参。理论证明每个校准样本量下该规则在加权可交换类中最优，并给出超额长度、选择池与重采样误差界。实验显示逆密度选择多数情形均值集更短、运行更快，覆盖略有差异。
papers.abstract_en: We study conformal prediction under covariate shift with a known covariate density ratio, seeking prediction sets with minimum expected length under the target distribution. For every calibration sample size, we prove that the rule combining the inverse conditional-density score with randomized weighted conformal calibration minimizes this expected length among all rules valid over the full weighted-exchangeability class.   We approximate the oracle using quantile and kernel histograms, including forest-weighted estimators, and select estimators and tuning parameters by resampling to estimate calibrated target length. On a bounded response domain, we bound excess length linearly in $L^1$ density error at fixed calibration size, without requiring a uniform positive lower bound on the true density. We also bound selection-pool and resampling errors. Under explicit growth conditions, the selected procedure approaches the same oracle while the calibration size remains fixed.   Experiments on 36 known-density configurations and four public regression datasets compare coverage, prediction-set length, and runtime with existing methods.   In targeted low-coverage and strong-shift comparisons, inverse-density selection yields shorter mean sets in most cases and lower mean runtime than the evaluated weighted baselines, with some differences in achieved coverage.

papers.title_en: Metric Conformal Prediction via the Conditional Expected Local Radius
papers.authors: Rui Qiu, Fang Yao, Zhou Yu
papers.evidence: 面向度量空间响应的新共形预测方法
papers.tldr: 针对非欧几里得响应的一般度量空间共形预测，现有方法难以兼顾异质性与多模态且计算昂贵。论文提出条件期望局部半径（CELR），以其条件分布构造跨协变量可比的非一致性分数，并适配度量分布随机森林一次拟合复用全部分数组件。理论证明估计量一致性与渐近条件有效性，交换性下保持有限样本边际覆盖。数值实验显示多度量空间下不确定性量化有效，且较条件剖面分数法显著节省计算。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the conditional expected local radius (CELR) and develop a new conformal prediction method for non-Euclidean responses in general metric spaces. CELR measures local conditional probability concentration, allowing prediction sets to accommodate heterogeneity and multimodality without requiring densities or a vector space structure. Its conditional distribution yields a nonconformity score that is comparable across covariate values and avoids costly transport comparisons between distance profiles. We further adapt a metric distributional random forest that handles multivariate covariates and nonlinear interactions, while a single forest fit supplies all score components, reducing computation by eliminating repeated local fitting. We establish uniform consistency of the estimators and asymptotic conditional validity under suitable regularity conditions, together with finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability. Numerical studies demonstrate effective uncertainty quantification across different metric spaces and substantial computational savings over the conditional profile score method.

papers.title_en: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
papers.authors: Kaiwen Wu, Chaochao Lu
papers.evidence: LLM 智能体构建并更新因果信念用于决策
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体多依赖记忆检索，缺少可形成并修正的因果理解。CauProphet受人类因果认知启发，构建并更新Causal Cognition，结合当前证据生成Causal Belief以指导决策。它在金融研究中平均秩相关较基线提升25.4%，动态场景预测准确率由21.3%升至28.6%。这表明持久化因果经验学习能增强下一代LLM智能体的决策与迁移能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.

papers.title_en: A Foundation Model for Policy In-Context Longitudinal Causal Effect Estimation
papers.authors: Wenxin Chen, Kyra Gan, Mingyu Lu, Zilin Jing, Fei Wang, Hoifung Poon, Tristan Naumann, Peniel Argaw
papers.evidence: 基于先验数据拟合网络的纵向因果效应估计基础模型
papers.tldr: 纵向因果效应估计受时变混杂与治疗-混杂反馈困扰，现有方法需逐数据集拟合且难以适配动态策略。PICLE-PFN将目标策略编码为上下文历史-决策示范，并在纵向结构因果模型合成数据上预训练，以前馈网络摊销估计。新数据集上单次前向即可预测CAPO，无需任务训练或调参。基准中取得有竞争力RMSE、更优不确定性校准且部署耗时大幅降低。
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal causal effect estimation is complicated by time-varying confounding and treatment-confounder feedback loops. Existing methods generally require data-specific nuisance-model fitting, and many are tailored to prespecified treatment sequences or prediction horizons, leading to time-consuming computation at deployment. We introduce *Policy In-Context Longitudinal causal Effect estimation with Prior-data Fitted Networks* (**PICLE-PFN**), the first foundation model for longitudinal causal effect estimation that supports *dynamic* treatment policies. PICLE-PFN represents target policies through in-context history-decision demonstrations, providing a unified interface for a broad class of treatment policies. Pretrained over synthetic data sampled from longitudinal structural causal models, PICLE-PFN amortizes causal effect estimation across datasets, policies, and horizons. Given a new observational dataset and target policy, it directly predicts conditional average potential outcomes (CAPOs) in one forward pass without task-specific training or hyperparameter tuning. Across synthetic and semi-synthetic longitudinal benchmarks, PICLE-PFN achieves competitive RMSE and substantially improved uncertainty calibration with a fraction of deployment runtime, compared to state-of-the-art conventional estimators trained and tuned separately for each dataset.

papers.title_en: Each Insufficient in Its Own Way: Calibrating Language Models Across Varying Evidence States
papers.authors: Jiayi Li, Dennis L. Shung, Bradly C. Stadie
papers.evidence: 跨证据状态的语言模型置信度校准
papers.tldr: 语言模型常在证据不足时仍作答，现有校准多忽略证据变化对置信度的影响。论文提出证据状态校准，要求回答前置信度匹配答对概率并随证据状态调整；所提 Sufficiency Confidence Estimation 微调模型 next-token 分布中的置信度，使其对齐各证据状态的经验答对率。在临床诊断和多跳问答、两家族四模型上，Brier score 最多降60%，AUROC 最多升0.16，置信度响应证据数量与具体内容。表明模型能学会判断当前证据是否足够回答。
papers.abstract_en: How can a language model know whether it has enough evidence to answer? Language models tend to answer even when the evidence they have is insufficient. Deciding whether to answer or gather more evidence requires a calibrated estimate of how likely an answer is to be correct with the available evidence. However, most calibration work treats the input as fixed, without asking how this estimate should change with the evidence. We introduce \emph{evidence-state calibration}, which requires a model's confidence before answering to match its probability of answering correctly and to change accordingly whenever the evidence changes this probability. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{Suffi}ciency \textbf{C}onfidence \textbf{E}stimation), which fine-tunes the confidence already present in a model's next-token distribution to match how often the model answers correctly from each evidence state. Across clinical diagnosis and multi-hop question answering with four models from two families, \ours{} reduces the Brier score by up to 60\% and increases AUROC by up to 0.16. Its confidence matches the empirical success rate and responds not only to the amount of evidence but also to which evidence is present, showing that models can learn to judge whether their current evidence is enough to answer.

papers.title_en: From Document Layout to Causal Topology: An End-to-End Architecture for Temporal Causal Reasoning
papers.authors: Zhifeng Yang, Wei Luo, Yongjian Chen, Shiqi Ou
papers.evidence: 用因果拓扑与因果拓扑注意力掩码提升大模型时序因果推理
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在时间推理中缺乏深层因果推断能力。本文受文档版面重排序启发，将离散叙事转为因果拓扑，提出免训练神经符号框架TCR-Agent与端到端模型TCR-Former，后者以因果拓扑注意力掩码和时间跨度偏置内化推理机制。在TempoCausal基准上，TCR-Agent超越免训练基线，TCR-Former以约8.6B参数较SOTA准确率提升16.5%，并优于GPT-5.4和DeepSeek-V3.2。工作揭示结构-推理脱节，并通过内化因果推理弥合差距。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) generally lack deep causal reasoning capabilities in temporal reasoning. Inspired by document layout reordering, this paper proposes a paradigm shift from discrete narratives to causal topologies. It constructs two architectures: a training-free neuro-symbolic framework, temporal causal reasoning agent (TCR-Agent), which achieves interpretable causal deduction and counterfactual truncation through external causal graph instantiation and a symbolic intervention engine; and an end-to-end model, temporal causal reasoning former (TCR-Former), which internalizes these mechanisms into the Transformer attention space via a Causal-Topological Attention Mask and temporal span biases. Experiments on the TempoCausal benchmark demonstrate that TCR-Agent comprehensively surpasses existing training-free baselines. At the same time, TCR-Former achieves an accuracy 16.5% higher than that of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, outperforming large-scale models such as GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2 with only approximately 8.6B parameters. Further analysis reveals a structure-reasoning disconnection phenomenon in existing methods: external symbolic constraints and chain-of-thought reasoning can improve reasoning steps, yet fail to enhance deep causal deductive capability. By internalizing temporal causal reasoning capabilities into the model, TCR-Former effectively bridges this gap, providing an efficient and reliable end-to-end foundation for complex reasoning scenarios.

papers.title_en: Recertifying decisions via e-closure: uniform improvements of conformal risk control and randomized e-BH
papers.authors: Tian Bai, Aaditya Ramdas
papers.evidence: 通过e-闭包再认证一致改进保形风险控制
papers.tldr: 风险受控决策常留下未用风险预算。该文基于e-value表示与e-closure提出“再认证”框架，把损失按预算归一化为状态索引e-value集合，利用分布结构扩大认证e-value并保持有效性。用于CRC时重分配校准样本中的闲置预算，得到不劣于CRC且有限可交换下有效的方法；用于随机e-BH时给出闭式程序，扩大拒绝集并提升期望拒绝数。实验显示预算利用、信息量与检验功效均改善。
papers.abstract_en: Statistical procedures often control expected loss at a prescribed level while leaving part of their risk budget unused. Building on the e-value representation of risk-controlled decisions and the e-closure principle for multiple testing, we formulate recertification, a general paradigm for improving procedures by exploiting computable slack in their validity certificates. A valid procedure's losses normalized by their risk budgets form a state-indexed e-value collection; conversely, decisions whose normalized losses are bounded by this collection inherit its risk guarantees. Recertification uses distributional structure to quantify slack, enlarge the certifying e-values while preserving validity, and construct less conservative decisions.   We develop two applications. For conformal risk control (CRC) with a known loss family, recertification redistributes unused risk budget among the held-out points of each hypothetical augmented sample. The resulting controller is valid under every finite exchangeable law and no more conservative than CRC on any calibration sample. For convex losses on an interval of actions, repeated recertification converges geometrically to an admissible controller. For false discovery rate control with arbitrarily dependent e-values, recertification exploits unused conditional budgets in randomized e-BH. It yields a closed-form randomized procedure whose rejection set contains that of randomized e-BH for every realization of the shared randomization and whose expected number of rejections is maximal subject to the same conditional budget constraints. Recertifying with the larger e-collection of closed e-BH gives a second closed-form procedure whose rejection set contains that of the first. Experiments on CIFAR-100 hierarchical classification and multiple testing simulations demonstrate improved budget utilization, informativeness and power over the baselines.

papers.title_en: Nonlinear Sufficient Dimension Reduction for Causal Inference with Continuous Treatments
papers.authors: Chak Fung Choi, Yin Tang, Bing Li
papers.evidence: 通过充分降维与IPW/结果回归估计连续处理下的因果效应
papers.tldr: 连续处理因果推断中，高维混杂使非参 nuisance 估计遭遇维数灾难。作者提出非线性充分降维框架，用广义Sliced Inverse Regression构造低维充分混杂子，并分别结合IPW、结果回归和AIPW估计因果效应。理论上降维估计收敛更快、率条件更弱且不增大渐近方差，模拟在高维下改善有限样本表现。该工作为连续处理因果推断缓解维数灾难提供了灵活途径。
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference with continuous treatments requires estimating nuisance functions to adjust for the potentially high-dimensional confounder, but nonparametric estimation of these functions is severely hampered by the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a nonlinear sufficient dimension reduction framework to construct low-dimensional sufficient confounders to preserve the unbiasedness of the treatment effect. We estimate the causal effect by combining the generalized Sliced Inverse Regression with the inverse probability weighting, outcome regression, and augmented inverse probability weighting, respectively. We further establish the convergence rates of the first two estimators and derive the asymptotic distributions of the third. Our theoretical results show that, compared to estimators based on the full covariates, dimension reduction yields faster convergence rates and weaker rate conditions without inflating the asymptotic variance. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed estimators improve finite-sample performance over their counterparts without dimension reduction, particularly when the original covariate dimension is high. These results demonstrate that sufficient dimension reduction provides a flexible approach to mitigating the curse of dimensionality in causal inference with continuous treatments.

papers.title_en: Conformal ordering: Distribution-free predictive inference for orders and rank
papers.authors: Yonghoon Lee, Zhimei Ren
papers.evidence: 面向排序与名次的分布无关共形推断
papers.tldr: 现有共形预测等方法主要处理未观测结果的预测与推断，但扩展到多个对象排序并给出可解释保证并不直接。本文将排序判定重构为图推断，采用多重检验思想构建仅保留高置信成对顺序的不确定性图，并在分布无关框架下控制FWER或FDR。该图进一步自然导出排名的风险控制预测区间。实验表明方法能紧贴目标保证，同时保持合理功效与区间宽度，为排序与排名预测提供通用推断工具。
papers.abstract_en: We study distribution-free predictive inference for the ordering and ranking of multiple unobserved outcomes. Although numerous methods, such as conformal prediction, have been developed for prediction and predictive inference of unobserved outcomes, extending them to provide inference for the ordering of multiple outcomes with an interpretable guarantee is not straightforward. To this end, we develop a framework and methodology for uncertainty quantification in predictive ordering.   Our approach begins by reformulating the problem of determining an ordering among multiple objects as a graph inference problem. Our method adopts a multiple-testing-inspired approach and constructs an uncertainty graph, where each edge represents a confidently inferred pairwise ordering. We develop a distribution-free procedure for constructing a consistent uncertainty graph while controlling either the family-wise error rate or the false discovery rate. Moreover, we show that the resulting graphs naturally yield risk-controlling prediction intervals for the ranks of the outcomes. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed procedure achieves the target guarantees tightly while maintaining reasonable power and prediction-interval widths.

papers.title_en: Identifiability from Stationary Covariance in Linear SDEs with Reciprocal Interactions and Latent Variables
papers.authors: Ana Leticia Garcez Vicente, Saber Salehkaleybar
papers.evidence: 含潜变量线性随机微分方程中的因果效应可识别性
papers.tldr: 连续时间线性SDE常用于建模交互动力系统，但其因果效应能否仅由平稳分布观测数据识别仍受限制。现有结论多要求系统全观测且因果图不含有向2-周期。本文先建立允许有向2-周期（互惠交互）的图条件，证明因果效应的通用可识别性；再面向潜变量导致的部分可观测，提出工具变量框架识别目标直接因果效应。该工作将线性SDE可识别性推广到互惠交互与隐变量场景。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time stochastic differential equations (SDEs) provide a natural framework for modeling interacting dynamical systems. A central causal question is whether causal effects among observed variables can be identified from observational data drawn from the stationary distribution, given the underlying causal graph. For linear SDEs, existing identifiability results are largely restricted to fully observed systems whose causal graphs contain no directed 2-cycles. We first establish new graphical conditions for the generic identifiability of causal effects in systems that may contain directed 2-cycles, thereby allowing for reciprocal interactions. Next, we address the previously unexplored setting of latent variables by developing an instrumental-variable framework for identifying a target direct causal effect under partial observability.

papers.title_en: "Not" is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLMs
papers.authors: Giang Son Nguyen, Wray Buntine, Dung D. Le, Wenya Wang
papers.evidence: 多语言大模型否定表示的因果干预
papers.tldr: 否定普遍存在于各语言，但表层实现差异大；多语言大模型却能稳健翻译否定，其跨语言表示是否共享尚不清楚。作者在六个开源模型、英法越中四种语言上，用合成对比数据与FLORES-200否定翻译数据做因果干预，提取对比激活方向并分析稀疏自编码器特征。结果显示否定表示可因果控制且跨语言高度对齐，单一SAE特征即可跨语言切换极性，干预还能泛化到另外四种语言和FLORES句子。该工作为多语言否定表示与可解释控制提供了证据、数据和代码。
papers.abstract_en: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suffices to control polarity across languages, while responding selectively to negated inputs. Finally, both dense and sparse interventions generalize to four additional languages and FLORES-derived sentences. We release data and code to support future work: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/negation-translation/.

papers.title_en: Optimal Correction Sets for Provable Redress of Contestable Causal Discovery
papers.authors: Fabrizio Russo, Giuseppe Mazzotta, Carmine Dodaro, Francesco Ricca, Francesca Toni
papers.evidence: 带修复机制的约束型因果发现
papers.tldr: 约束式因果发现依赖CI检验，但有限样本下检验常冲突，导致无因果图满足全部约束。本文将CI事实修复形式化为最小代价校正问题，并用ASP编码因果一致性与最优稳定模型。研究证明最优稳定模型与最小代价校正集双向投影对应，可给出释放事实的冲突解释与形式化补救保证。实验显示OptABA-PC保留更多正确事实、减少兼容输出歧义并改善图重建。
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based causal discovery relies on conditional-independence (CI) tests that may conflict in finite samples, leaving no causal graph that satisfies them all. Causal Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA) makes these tests explicit as defeasible commitments, and offers correspondence guarantees with a subset of them, but its existing repair procedure releases facts heuristically and offers no formal response to a user's contestation of a release. We argue that contestable causal discovery requires an inspectable repair object, a justification for it, and a predictable revision procedure for such contestations. We therefore formulate CI-fact repair as a minimum-cost correction problem and implement it in Answer Set Programming (ASP). Building on Causal ABA, we provide a compact and efficient ASP encoding of causal consistency, with soundness and completeness guarantees, and a two-way projection correspondence between optimal stable models and minimum-cost correction sets. These results establish fidelity to retained facts, subset-minimality and cost optimality of the repair, conflict-based justifications for released facts, and formally guaranteed redress under user contestations. An empirical evaluation supports the formal account: OptABA-PC retains more correct facts, reduces ambiguity in the compatible outputs, and improves graph reconstruction over Causal ABA on common benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Intervene, Calibrate, Discover: Learning Causal Structure from Pixels
papers.authors: Ziyi Ding, Xiaodi Huang, Xianxin Lai, Haijier Chen, Zhang Zhang, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Jiayu Chen
papers.evidence: 通过干预从像素中学习因果结构
papers.tldr: 从像素学习高层因果变量时，视觉读出误差会使模型设定与环境干预值错位。该方法将图像读出与固定轮转干预获得的验证值配对，在冻结编解码器后用逐维可逆校准映射统一数值单位。随后智能体主动干预以判定因果方向并拟合局部机制，反校准可还原反事实状态。在 Domino、CausalWorld 等基准上，校准降低了匹配数据下预测变化误差，并支持图发现、干预后果与反事实图像评估。
papers.abstract_en: Learning high-level causal variables from low-level observations is a central problem for artificial intelligence. With known node semantics but an unknown graph, visual readout errors can misalign model settings with environment intervention values. We address this mismatch by pairing image readouts with verified values attained through fixed round-robin interventions. With encoder and decoder frozen, a dimension-wise invertible calibration map puts visual responses and target settings in shared numerical units. After freezing this map, the agent selects interventions to resolve graph directions and fits local mechanisms to predict consequences; inverse calibration returns counterfactual states to the decoder's original coordinates. Across Domino, Pick-and-Place, Balance, Gears, CAUSAL3D, and CausalWorld, we evaluate graph discovery, intervention consequences, and counterfactual images. Controlled domino experiments show that interventions resolve orientation ambiguity left by equal additional observations. In a matched-data domino control, calibration reduces the mean error of predicted changes in other variables within the same factual context, relative to an uncalibrated model.

papers.title_en: Why Are LLMs Confidently Wrong? Correcting Overconfident Errors via Causal Head Intervention
papers.authors: Jing Ren, Bowen Li, Ziqi Xu, Xuechao Yang, Feng Xia
papers.evidence: 通过因果头干预纠正过度自信错误以提升大模型校准
papers.tldr: 大语言模型常出现高置信错误，现有校准多依赖事后调整或重训，难以触及内部成因。CoCHI依据预测的正确性—置信模式，定位并因果干预与类别相关的内部注意力头。在多个LLM和五个多选题基准上，它降低ECE、NLL与Brier并保持准确率。该工作把校准从输出层推向模型机制层面，为提升可靠性提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) often exhibit overconfident errors, assigning high confidence to incorrect predictions and thereby undermining reliability in real-world use. Existing calibration methods typically rely on post-hoc adjustment or retraining, operating at the output level without addressing the underlying causes of miscalibration. We propose CoCHI, (Class-oriented Causal Head Intervention), a framework that improves calibration by identifying and intervening on internal components responsible for distinct confidence behaviours. By analysing predictions through correctness-confidence patterns, CoCHI enables targeted intervention on model internals, reducing overconfident errors while preserving correct predictions. Our approach provides a mechanistic perspective on calibration, linking reliability to identifiable structures within the model rather than treating it as an output-level issue. Experiments across multiple LLMs show consistent improvements in calibration metrics, including Expected Calibration Error, Negative Log-Likelihood, and Brier Score, while maintaining accuracy on five multiple-choice question answering benchmarks. These results suggest that effective calibration requires not only adjusting outputs, but also addressing the underlying causal mechanisms within the model.

papers.title_en: Interpreting Model Reasoning through Behavioral Counterfactuals
papers.authors: Shawn Im, James Oldfield, Adel Bibi, Sharon Li
papers.evidence: 用行为反事实分析干预如何改变模型推理
papers.tldr: 大模型思维链的内部机制难以忠实解释，采样方差使干预效果难以隔离。论文提出行为反事实方法：固定回答，训练模块编辑残差流，使源提示与反事实目标提示的输出分布KL最小。实验表明匹配输出分布比常规激活重构更能恢复反事实行为，模块归因可定位因果关键位置。案例中该方法揭示建议如何通过问题陈述与填充词表征影响推理和最终答案。
papers.abstract_en: Faithfully understanding the internal process that occurs as models form their chain of thought is an important problem with the rise in model capabilities. However, this remains challenging due to the variance in sampled responses, making it difficult to isolate the effects of interventions and compare model reasoning systematically. We propose a method for localizing and analyzing how a given intervention affects the model's reasoning through behavioral counterfactuals: given a fixed response, how does introducing an intervention to the prompt change the next-token distributions? We train a module to edit the residual stream such that it minimizes the KL divergence between the output distributions for a fixed response under a source prompt and its counterfactual target prompt. We find that matching the output distributions recovers the counterfactual behavior more effectively than standard activation reconstruction objectives and validate that attribution of the trained module outputs is effective for identifying causally important locations for counterfactual recovery. The attribution maps and visualizations of the downstream effects of model edits provide an interface for generating hypotheses about the original model's computation, which can then be tested with activation patching. In a case study on Gemma-4-E4B-it and DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, we investigate how a suggestion influences model reasoning even when it is not verbally acknowledged. Our analysis identifies representations at the question statement and filler tokens that mediate a substantial part of the suggestion's influence, with downstream effects such as changing the framing of the justification or even the final answer.

papers.title_en: Strategic Calibration in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: Audited Pivot Scoring for Truthful Elicitation
papers.authors: Jinhao Zhou, Zhaohan Zhang, Xijian Xu, Jun Wu
papers.evidence: LLM 多智能体决策中的策略性置信度校准
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体系统中，置信度影响下游注意力、算力与决策权分配，智能体因而可能策略性夸大贡献，而现有校准多假设被动报告。作者将问题建模为报告层激励问题，提出审计枢轴评分机制APSM，融合平台收益抵消、逆倾向加权稀疏审计、Clarke枢轴外部性与严格适当评分。实验显示Top-K激励下LLM会抬高置信度；APSM降低Brier损失与截断越界，并把抵抗分配改变偏离的效用裕度扩大1.93倍。这使激励感知的置信度诱导成为可靠多智能体协调的独立层面。
papers.abstract_en: In large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, reported confidence increasingly determines the allocation of scarce downstream attention, computation, and decision influence. This makes reporting strategic: an agent may overstate the relevance of its contribution even when its underlying belief is well calibrated. Existing calibration methods largely assume passive reporting and therefore do not address strategic incentives created when confidence determines downstream allocation. We formulate strategic calibration as a reporting-layer incentive problem and propose the Audited Pivot Scoring Mechanism (APSM). APSM offsets platform-controlled allocation benefits, uses inverse-propensity-weighted sparse audits, charges the Clarke pivot externality, and applies a strictly proper score. Under the stated model assumptions, truthful reporting is the unique expected-utility best response. We also characterize approximate execution and the audit-variance trade-off. Calculator-free experiments show that LLM agents inflate confidence under Top-$K$ incentives. With a shared agent-local utility interface, LLM agents reduce distortion under both Compensated Proper Scoring (CPS) and APSM. CPS achieves higher exact allocation match, whereas APSM yields lower Brier loss and numerically fewer cutoff crossings. Experiments further show that APSM enlarges the utility margin against allocation-changing deviations by $1.93\times$ and improves robustness under approximate execution. These results support incentive-aware elicitation as a distinct layer for reliable multi-agent coordination.

papers.title_en: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
papers.authors: Harine Choi, Chenchen Kuai, Zihao Li, Jiwan Jiang, Yunlong Zhang, Zhiwen Fan, Zhengzhong Tu, Yang Zhou
papers.evidence: 关注大模型自置信度失准及LLM评判者的校准质量
papers.tldr: 针对LLM/MLLM自置信度校准差但可用于高效评测的问题，本文建立统一统计框架，涵盖置信度分层直接审计与LLM裁判辅助评估。直接审计无需校准置信度即可恢复总体准确率并刻画有限样本不确定性；裁判评估用敏感性和假阳性率校正误差。MMLU-Pro/MMMU-Pro实验表明分层审计统计有效，比例分配在高偏置信分布下显著降误差；裁判辅助仅少数目标-验证器对满足理想效率条件，推理成本限制节省。
papers.abstract_en: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.   This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.   Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

papers.title_en: Identifying and disentangling direct and spillover effects using multiple pre-treatment periods
papers.authors: Martin Huber
papers.evidence: 利用多期预处理期识别干扰下的直接与溢出处理效应
papers.tldr: 干扰下处理效应含直接与溢出分量，常规非处理对照组无法分别识别二者。本文利用多个预处理期，在无预期下用组内预处理趋势外推反事实，并构造双重稳健、Neyman正交估计。结果可分别识别处理组总效应与非处理组溢出效应，模拟验证根号n渐近正态与标准误可靠；1919年专利强制许可应用显示许可同时提升被许可及技术相近子类专利，对照设计低估总效应。该框架为无未污染对照组的干扰场景提供识别与推断工具。
papers.abstract_en: Under interference, the treatment of some units affects the outcomes of others, so that the effect on a treated unit consists of a direct and a spillover component. A non-treated comparison group then generally identifies neither component, but the difference between the total effect on the treated and the spillover effect on the comparison units. We show that both components are identified separately when multiple pre-treatment periods are available, without an uncontaminated comparison group. Under no anticipation, pre-treatment outcomes are free of both components for every unit. Extrapolating the pre-treatment trend within a group, as in interrupted time series approaches, therefore identifies the counterfactual outcome in the absence of any treatment. Applied to the treated it gives the total effect on them, applied to the non-treated at a given level of exposure the spillover effect on them. Disentangling the two components in addition requires effect homogeneity across treated and non-treated units with the same exposure and covariates, as well as common support in exposure. We derive doubly robust and Neyman-orthogonal expressions for the effects of interest, which permits controlling for covariates by machine learning, and establish asymptotic normality. A simulation study confirms the root-$n$ behaviour of the estimators and the reliability of the standard errors. We apply the framework to the compulsory licensing of enemy-owned patents in the United States in 1919. Licensing raised patenting in the licensed subclasses and in technologically close ones alike, so that a comparison-group design understates the total effect.

papers.title_en: Convex Mixed-Integer Programming for Invariant Predictions from Multi-environment Data
papers.authors: Xiaozhu Zhang, Rahul Mazumder, Armeen Taeb
papers.evidence: 从多环境数据中识别不变因果预测变量
papers.tldr: 多环境数据中，因果预测变量可由跨环境保持不变的预测关系识别。论文在线性模型下提出LSCR不变性原则，要求普通最小二乘系数与预测风险在各环境均保持不变，并构造不变性得分。基于该得分设计联合最小化预测风险与不变性惩罚的估计器，以及无需完全可识别性的检验流程，二者均转化为凸混合整数优化并给出最优性证书。模拟与真实数据表明其在统计和计算上显著优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous data provide an opportunity to identify causal predictors by revealing which predictive relationships remain invariant. Under a linear model, we introduce a least-squares coefficient-and-risk (LSCR) invariance principle, requiring both ordinary least squares coefficients and prediction risks to remain constant across environments. Our model neither specifies an intervention mechanism nor assumes a structural causal model for the entire system. We develop an invariance score that quantifies departures from LSCR invariance and use its optimization to construct two complementary procedures for causal predictor identification. First, we propose an estimator that jointly minimizes prediction risk and invariance penalty, and establish non-asymptotic guarantees for estimation and recovery of the causal parents under suitable identifiability conditions. Second, without requiring full identifiability, we develop a testing procedure that minimizes the invariance score over all predictor sets excluding a given variable, enabling valid causal discoveries with asymptotic error control via a multiplier bootstrap. Both procedures admit convex mixed-integer optimization formulations that avoid exhaustive subset enumeration while providing certificates of optimality. Simulations and real data experiments demonstrate substantial statistical and computational improvements over existing methods.

papers.title_en: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
papers.authors: Franco Rugolon, Ioanna Miliou, Panagiotis Papapetrou
papers.evidence: 面向多模态分类器的后置模型无关反事实检索
papers.tldr: 多模态分类器缺乏事后反事实解释，现有方法按模态独立归因，难以形成连贯解释且不适用于任意预训练架构。CRANE提出模型无关的最近邻多模态反事实检索框架，从目标类真实训练样本中检索候选解释，以保证合理性。在四个异构数据集和三种融合策略上，多模态共识检索MC-R在四分之三数据集取得最佳或并列最佳，解释锚定联合训练分布。该工作为多模态分类器提供了首个事后、模型无关的反事实解释方案。
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every explanation in the joint training distribution. Unimodal strategies remain competitive when a single modality dominates the decision boundary.

papers.title_en: Faithful Federated Tabular Data Synthesis
papers.authors: Zilong Cao, Hai Zhang, Xuan Bi
papers.evidence: 面向混合类型表格数据的高保真合成
papers.tldr: 联邦场景下混合类型表格数据合成需兼顾分布保真与离散变量处理。FITS用局部线性回归分两步联邦估计条件CDF，并基于概率链式法则生成合成数据；其连续化方法将离散变量映射到连续空间且无损还原离散分布。理论分析给出连续化混合变量的条件密度/CDF刻画及联邦条件CDF估计的一致收敛性。实验显示合成数据提升所有客户端下游任务，收益取决于使用方式。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era. This paper studies the generation of mixed-type tabular synthetic data in federated settings, where two key challenges arise: ensuring distributional fidelity and effectively handling mixed-type data. We propose Federated Integrative Two-Step Synthesis (FITS), a framework for mixed-type tabular data synthesis. At its core is a two-step federated algorithm for estimating conditional cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) using local linear regression. Building on this algorithm, we develop a federated synthesis procedure based on the probability chain rule to ensure distributional fidelity. To handle mixed-type data, FITS introduces a continualization method that lifts discrete variables into a continuous space and recovers their discrete distributions without loss at both the density-function and CDF levels. This transformation provides a unified continuous representation of mixed-type variables, facilitating the application of local linear regression and synthetic data generation. Our theoretical analysis characterizes the conditional density and cumulative distribution functions of the continualized mixed-type variables and establishes the uniform convergence of the resulting federated conditional CDF estimators. Experiments demonstrate that FITS-generated synthetic data improves downstream task performance for all clients, with the benefits depending on how the synthetic data is used.

papers.title_en: ConMem: Counterfactual Multi-Scenario Probing for Resolving LLM Memory Misalignment
papers.authors: Shuning Zhang, Tenghao Ji, Jingruo Chen, Eryue Xu, Bohao Chu, Xin Yi
papers.evidence: 将大模型记忆保留重构为前瞻性反事实因果推断
papers.tldr: 长期记忆对多会话长程LLM智能体至关重要，但现有记忆常过度泛化、错误归因或泄露隐私，形成记忆错位。为此作者构建MemAlign基准，并提出ConMem，将记忆保留决策重构为前瞻性反事实因果推断，通过合成反事实交互场景审计下游干预效果。实验取得75.16%准确率、64.15%平衡准确率和65.31% Macro-F1，在缓解过度保留偏差的同时保持个性化效用。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is critical for autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents executing multi-session, long-horizon tasks. However, existing memories often inappropriately store, retain, or retrieve over-generalized, misattributed, or privacy-sensitive information, a problem we term memory misalignment. To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. We then propose ConMem, an algorithm that reframes retention decisions as prospective counterfactual causal inference. \textbf{ConMem} synthesizes counterfactual interaction scenarios to prospectively audit downstream intervention effects across three aspects: relevant task execution, irrelevant invariance checks, and risk-sensitive boundary shifts. Experiments show that ConMem outperforms other methods, achieving 75.16\% accuracy, 64.15\% balanced accuracy, and a Macro-F1 of 65.31\%, effectively mitigating over-retention biases without sacrificing personalization utility.

papers.title_en: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
papers.authors: Katie Matton, Rosalind W. Picard, John Guttag, Maggie Makar
papers.evidence: 在测试阶段生成捷径变量的反事实编辑以改进大模型预测
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可能依赖训练数据中的捷径相关性，测试分布偏移时预测变差，而现有去捷径方法多需训练期标签、权重和算力。本文研究测试时捷径移除，提出反事实测试时增强CTTA：用辅助模型改写捷径值，并对LLM在多个反事实编辑上的预测加权平均。理论上证明最优捷径不变预测器属于CTTA族，并给出权重可识别条件及假设检验，进而提出Select-CTTA。实验显示其优于测试时基线，接近捷径平衡数据微调模型。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate method that selects among CTTA methods. Empirically, we find that Select-CTTA outperforms test-time baselines and approaches the performance of models fine-tuned on shortcut-balanced data.
